title: US Q3 Earnings Season Kicks Off With Big Banks; Futures Steady Ahead of CPI/PPI
summary: Gotrade News - Third-quarter earnings season opens Tuesday, October 13, when JPMorgan Chase (JPM) , Goldman Sachs (GS) , Wells Fargo (WFC) and Citigroup
body_markdown:

Tuesday carries the heaviest bank slate, with JPMorgan Chase expected to post $5.93 per share and Goldman Sachs $13.04, according to FXEmpire. Health care giants Johnson & Johnson and UnitedHealth Group also report the same morning.

## Wednesday, October 14: Bank of America (BAC) and 6 More


Bank of America and Morgan Stanley report on the same morning the September CPI lands at 12:30 GMT. Per FXEmpire, headline CPI is forecast at 0.6% month over month and 3.6% year over year, up from 0.4% and 3.4% in the prior reading, while core CPI is seen at 0.2% month over month and 2.5% year over year.

## Thursday, October 15: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) and 9 More


Thursday brings the producer price index at 12:30 GMT, with FXEmpire listing forecasts of 0.5% month over month for headline PPI and 0.3% for core PPI.


[Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/tsmc-q3-revenue-surges-50-on-ai-demand/) reports the same morning with an EPS estimate of $4.48, alongside PNC, Charles Schwab and U.S. Bancorp.

## CPI and PPI Frame the Bank Reports


The inflation data lands in the middle of the bank reports.[Writing on Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/article/4953377-cpi-ppi-and-q3-earnings-soon-october-could-end-roughly) , David H. Lerner described his own stance as "tactically cautious" heading into the week.


> "Persistent high rates and volatility may pressure valuations further, with upcoming CPI and PPI data as key catalysts for short-term market direction." (David H. Lerner, Seeking Alpha)


Several Federal Reserve officials are also on FXEmpire's schedule, including Governor Waller on Tuesday and Governor Bowman on Wednesday and Thursday.
